transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I'm here because I've been struggling with these constant, unwanted thoughts that I just can't get out of my head. To deal with them, I feel forced to do certain habits and rituals over and over, and it's really starting to interfere with my daily life. I just... I don't know how to make it stop.

When these thoughts come up, do they feel intrusive and unwanted, and do you do the rituals mainly to relieve the anxiety they cause? Or are you mostly worried about many different everyday problems even when you are not doing rituals?

Yes, the thoughts are incredibly intrusive and distressing, and they feel completely out of my control. I do the rituals, like washing my hands or checking the locks, specifically to get relief from the intense anxiety and doubt they trigger. It's not about normal everyday worries; I just feel forced to do them to make the panic go away.
Do you recognize that these thoughts and rituals are excessive or unreasonable, even though they still feel impossible to resist?
I'm not really sure, and I haven't thought about whether they're unreasonable or not. I just know that the urge to do them is so overwhelming that it feels like I have no choice.
About how much time do these thoughts and rituals take each day, and are they causing problems at work, school, or in your relationships?

I'm not quite sure of the exact hours I spend on them, but it definitely feels like a really large part of my day. I also haven't really thought about how much it interferes with my work or relationships, I just know it's incredibly exhausting.
Do you ever feel completely certain that the feared harm will happen if you do not do the ritual, or hear or see things that other people do not?

No, I definitely don't hear or see things that other people don't. I also wouldn't say I'm completely certain that the harm will actually happen, but the anxiety and the urge to perform the rituals are just too strong to ignore.
How long have you been having these intrusive thoughts and rituals, and did they start gradually or after a particular stressful event?
I'm not quite sure how long this has been going on, to be honest. I also don't really know exactly how it started or if there was a specific event that triggered it.
Do you avoid certain places, objects, or situations because they trigger these thoughts or make you feel you have to do the rituals?
I don't really avoid specific places or situations. I just try to deal with the thoughts and rituals whenever and wherever they happen to come up.
Have you ever had repeated movements or sounds you could not control, like blinking, throat clearing, or facial grimacing?
No, I have never experienced any uncontrollable movements or sounds like blinking or clearing my throat. My struggles are really just limited to the thoughts and rituals I described.
Have these symptoms ever seemed related to using alcohol, cannabis, stimulants, or any new medications, or to a medical problem like a head injury or seizure?
No, I don't think these symptoms are related to alcohol, drugs, or any medications at all. I also haven't had any head injuries, seizures, or other medical issues that could have caused this.
During this time, have you also had long periods of feeling very down or depressed, or times when you felt unusually energized, needed much less sleep, and your thoughts were racing?
No, I haven't experienced prolonged periods of feeling down or depressed. I also haven't had times where I felt unusually energized or had racing thoughts.
